focus.name: menu-palette-record-bank
focus.purpose: Bound the palette-shaped bank staged by the options-menu path while preserving the unresolved runtime transfer semantics.

format_evidence.word_rule: Every word is a valid 12-bit Genesis CRAM color encoding with zero high nibble and even RGB nibbles.

limitations: The direct LEA stages A0, but the subsequent path branches over an unresolved 0x001B3C5E-0x001B3C63 fragment and no palette-copy loop consuming A0 is established.
The bank is therefore classified by exact palette-record shape and menu staging context; individual record themes and active upload timing remain unresolved.
